description: Figure 3 is a line chart illustrating the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis represents the different model variants, ordered as: “Full model (MS-FSLHate)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis represents performance metrics in percentage, ranging from 55% to 66%, with major tick marks at 55, 57, 59, 61, 63, 65, and 67. Three distinct lines are plotted: a solid blue line for Precision, a dashed red line for Recall, and a dotted green line for F1-score. The blue Precision line starts at 65.45% for the full model, dips to 61.06% without prompt, rises slightly to 62.22% without augmentation, then to 64.06% without attention, and ends at 65.44% without both prompt and augmentation. The red Recall line begins at 65.78%, drops to 59.64% without prompt, increases to 63.75% without augmentation, falls to 59.17% without attention, and ends at 56.82% without prompt and augmentation. The green F1-score line starts at 65.56%, drops to 60.16% without prompt, rises to 62.63% without augmentation, falls to 59.67% without attention, and ends at 57.74% without prompt and augmentation. All three lines show the highest performance for the full model and generally decline with the removal of components, with the most significant drops occurring when attention or both prompt and augmentation are removed.
